## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Collection of Pointing to the Return*

by [吳悞](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%B3%E6%82%9E) (Wú Wù) — Southern-Sòng Daoist alchemist

Wú Wù's companion-anthology to his practical manual [KR5c0298](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0298) *Dān fáng xū zhī* 丹房須知 — a collection of alchemical sayings, aphorisms, and exegetical pointers. Dated c. 1163. Preserved as **DZ 921** / CT 921 (*Dòngshén bù, Zhòng shù lèi* 洞神部眾術類).

**Dating.** c. 1163. Dynasty: 南宋.
